entities.name: control_numbers
entities.proposal_reason: Traceability spine (full definition in 02_control_numbers). Every control-number-bearing entity here FKs to value.

entities.name: submitters
entities.proposal_reason: DESIGN: re-introduce submitter as a lookup. Legacy DROPPED the submitters table and samples.submitter_id in 2016_11_21_200733_drop_submitter_table.php; this entity and its FK from samples are a unified-design re-introduction, not as-built.

entities.name: test_runs

source_columns: DESIGN: denormalized tenant convenience column. Legacy test_runs never carried facility_prefix; migration 2018_04_26 added facility_id (FK->locations) which 2018_05_10 DROPPED in favor of control_number_id. Tenant/facility is derived from the control_number (control_numbers.facility_prefix); kept here nullable only as a read convenience and is redundant with the cn FK.

entities.proposal_reason: Control# type 16. Groups samples into a run.

entities.name: samples

source_columns: the sampled material (a package, etc.) — control_number_sample
DESIGN: FK to the re-introduced submitters lookup; legacy dropped submitter_id in 2016_11_21_200733_drop_submitter_table.php.

lab location where the sample was tested — 2018_05_28_153406_add_test_lab_location_to_samples_table.php (integer unsigned FK->locations onDelete set null). Unified to a text facility control_number/key (facilities, 01_identity).
user who created/owns the submission — 2016_07_31_223750_add_user_id_to_sample_table.php (unsignedInteger). Cross-department link to users/employees (01_identity).
2018_03_27_194052 weight double(8,2), renamed to gross_mass in 2018_05_11_184839
2018_05_11_184839 tare_mass double(8,2) default 0 (retyped float in 2018_05_17); net submitted mass = gross_mass - tare_mass
2018_05_08_172208_add_extraction_volume_to_samples_table.php float(5,2) default 0 — solvent volume used in prep, to back-calculate concentrations
2016_07_06_100115_add_is_archtype_flag_to_sample_table.php boolean default false — flags the archetype/reference sample for its variety

entities.proposal_reason: A sample + its results are the single lab feed that fans out: batch release reads the COA (07_quality_batch), consumer profile renders ratios/terpene bars (09), sales uses strain data (10). test_facility_id/user_id link to facilities/users (01_identity).

entities.name: cannabinoids
entities.proposal_reason: Wide per-sample chemistry (1:1). Full legacy panel is the concrete 16-analyte set (thca,cbda,cbga,cbca,thcva,cbdva,cbgva,thc,cbd,cbg,cbc,thcv,cbdv,cbgv,cbn,d8_thc) + total_cannabinoids, per 2015_11_24_041924_create_cannabinoids_table.php.

entities.name: terpenes

source_columns: DESIGN: representative subset shown. Legacy panel is ~55 analyte columns (36 in 2015_11_24_041910_create_terpenes_table.php + 19 added in 2018_05_11_195605_add_missing_terpenes_to_sample_terpene_table.php), each decimal(7,5); total_terpenes is decimal(6,4). Kept wide-table here for diagram clarity rather than EAV.

entities.proposal_reason: DESIGN: wide per-sample terpene panel (1:1). Representative compounds shown; the real legacy panel is ~55 analyte columns (36 created + 19 added) + total_terpenes. Wide table kept over an EAV/analyte-row design for diagram readability.

entities.name: lims_pending_coas

lims.py raw_payload JSONB not null — full external-lab webhook payload

lims.py decided_by_id FK->users.id — reviewer who accepted/rejected (01_identity)

entities.proposal_reason: DESIGN: modern QMS landing/staging table for the external-lab (LIMS/Confident Labs) COA webhook the DFD models (ext_lab -> proc_ingest). Per qms-platform/backend/app/models/lims.py LIMSPendingCOA. accepted_batch_id links to batches (07_quality_batch); decided_by_id links to users (01_identity).

relationships.name: sampled from
evidence: DESIGN: on_delete set_null (don't delete a sample when its source-material CN is removed). As-built origin_control_number_id was onDelete CASCADE (2018_03_19_163819). In TARGET a control_number is immutable/never deleted so on_delete is largely moot.

external_entities.name: LIMS (Confident Labs)
external_entities.description: External lab; returns COA chemistry via webhook

processes.name: Create Sample / Test Run
processes.description: Draw a sample from material; group into a SAMP-N run

processes.name: Ingest Lab Results
processes.description: Single LIMS writer → cannabinoids/terpenes; fans out to batch/profile/sales

business_rules.title: Chemistry values are strings (DECIMAL)
business_rules.statement: Cannabinoid/terpene results are decimal strings (e.g. "15.5"), never numbers — passing numbers throws.

business_rules.title: 16-analyte cannabinoid + 8-analyte terpene panels
business_rules.statement: Cannabinoid panel = 16 analytes (acid+neutral forms); terpene panel = representative 8-analyte subset.

business_rules.title: Results are append-only
business_rules.statement: Cannabinoid/terpene result rows are immutable (1:1 per sample, no updates); DB triggers enforce.

connectors.name: Seam 1 — Control-Number authority
connectors.trigger: Any context mints a traceable record
connectors.effect: A single immutable control number ({prefix}{YYMMDD}-{genocode}, 18 type codes) is issued and never edited/deleted

connectors.name: Seam 3 — LIMS webhook fan-out
connectors.effect: Creates a test-run + records cannabinoid/terpene results AND seeds a consumer-profile (PhytoFacts) from the same payload
connectors.contract: { facilityPrefix, genocode, sample.testId, cannabinoids, terpenes } -> { labResults, consumerProfile }
